title: ∂[[E]] is supported in N when E ⊆ N and (N̄∖N) ∩ U = ∅
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let N, E ⊆ ℝ^P with (N̄ ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅ and E ⊆ N, let ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) be arbitrary, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy T(ω) = ∫_E ⟨dω, ξ_N⟩ dH^{n+1} for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξ_N). Then spt T ⊆ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → E ⊆ N → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → T.support ⊆ N
